workflow_runs.name: Check
workflow_runs.display_title: kb: add an optional managed cluster provider

head_commit.message:
kb: add an optional managed cluster provider

Enable the provider when siteConfig.clusterDefaults.kb is configured.
Delegate lifecycle operations to the pinned standalone engine and use its
matching read validators for owned snapshots. Preserve creation provenance
across compatible package transitions.

Route capture leases through public dispatch, translating only the managed
descriptor digest. Removal inventory avoids recursively locking the session;
omitting KB defaults retains the existing provider set.

Use the selected engine readiness predicate, including its exact run-ready
marker, before exporting a capture connection. A live draining runner retains
management ownership without granting capture readiness.

workflow_runs.name: Check
workflow_runs.display_title: review: require consolidation of superseded dependency updates

head_commit.message:
review: require consolidation of superseded dependency updates

The final history review accepted successive channel pins because they had
been deployed during development. Require an independent conclusion for
repeated update streams and evidence for any necessary retained boundary.

Mechanical content exemptions do not remove history consolidation duties.
Preserve supported behavior, migration lineage and required source refs;
keep rollout provenance separate from the rationale for commit retention.

workflow_runs.name: Check
workflow_runs.display_title: vpsadmin: preserve existing copies when choosing VPS backup placement

head_commit.message:
vpsadmin: preserve existing copies when choosing VPS backup placement

Legacy member NAS and VPS roots can have equal logical names. Add an optional
VPS backup filesystem so an empty hypervisor source can use a distinct root
without moving an existing copy or its history. Omission retains profile v1;
explicit selection emits strict v2 with two bounded allowed destinations.

Share source-Pool classification and existing-copy validation across Plan,
CatchUp and the confirmed payload reader. Reuse the sole valid allowed copy
before consulting the preferred destination. Refuse foreign, multiple,
closed, unrelated pending and aliased copies without a fallback or second
copy; retain current locking admission before staging and enrollment.

Enumerate every configured Pool for provisioning and physical preflight.
Give inspection its own typed v2 contract and compare loaded placement with
desired routing before effects. Finish payload admission before SSH or waits.

Compatible writers must converge before affected enrollment or dispatch.
Active v1 rollback is unsupported after v2-only copies exist. Keep enabled
preserving seeds and storage through retirement and re-enrollment. This
policy does not repair a retained alias, adopt a filesystem or move copies;
existing recovery and package delivery remain separate operations.

workflow_runs.name: Check
workflow_runs.display_title: vpsadmin: separate member NAS backup namespaces

head_commit.message:
vpsadmin: separate member NAS backup namespaces

Member NAS and VPS roots used numeric IDs in the same backup pool. Equal
IDs could admit distinct catalog owners of one physical path and fail a
later transfer after create -p had accepted the shared root.

Name new member NAS roots nas-<user-id> and reuse only a sole validated
legacy or canonical NAS. Refuse ambiguous, foreign or pending roots
without creating a replacement or changing existing identities.

Check the exact backup node, pool filesystem and dataset name with a
current locking read after storage admission. Reject confirmed or
pending competing owners, including Pool aliases, before backup creation
or Plan enrollment. Exclude only the validated reused DIP and let the
owning User, VPS or CatchUp staging roll back on refusal.

All profile writers must load this helper before enrollment. Active old
helpers cannot safely recognize new prefixed roots; use the supported
preserving retired selection before such a rollback. Existing aliases
remain unresolved, and metadata retirement does not remove their data.

workflow_runs.name: Check
workflow_runs.display_title: vpsadmin: meet the guest seed memory minimum in the payload fixture

head_commit.message:
vpsadmin: meet the guest seed memory minimum in the payload fixture

Request 1024 MiB for the fixture VPS so the selected guest seed admits
creation before the payload checks. Keep the other resource requests and
the production allocation rules unchanged.

Check the actual Guest.prepare! request against a bounded numeric
projection of the selected API's test seed. Stop at the ordinary VPS
operation boundary so the regression creates no physical work; the
owning payload scenario retains creation and transfer coverage.

workflow_runs.name: Check
workflow_runs.display_title: vpsadmin: record retained selections and recover copied DNS

head_commit.message:
vpsadmin: record retained selections and recover copied DNS

The full build result could select rebuilt DNS closures even when only
services or a Node had actually updated. Retained boot must use proven
machine selections rather than promote every descriptor from that build.

Record one private applied envelope, publishing a pending operation before
copy or boot and promoting only targets with exact system and rooted
closure proof. Preserve unknown legacy residency and refuse incomplete
cold starts or incompatible requested layouts.

Add stopped metadata-only recovery for a completed services copy whose DNS
selection is unproved. Restore entire prior DNS descriptors, preserve the
copied services and actual Nodes, and archive the predecessor and evidence
before publishing the corrected hold. Full copied boot, seed and refresh
proof still precede applied completion and release.

Write hold version 2 while keeping mask, seed and evidence version 1 and
runtime schema 1/policy 3. Legacy holds remain readable; recovered state
requires a compatible provider for rollback. Extend the existing native
fixture with one retained DNS root and the unproved legacy selection.

Retain the selected host boot inputs independently of raw config JSON,
which registers no references to the paths embedded in its contents. Use
explicit indirect roots for existing non-derivation items before effects
and publication, refusing missing inputs without build or substitution.

Keep exact config sources with path-derived roots so identical JSON bytes
at different store paths retain both provenance items. Recovery roots only
the corrected selected payloads and rechecks roots on identical retries.
Roots and historical evidence accumulate across updates and survive stop;
no automatic pruning or disk-space reclamation is promised.

Require initial counted-service readiness before the fixture baseline and
keep bounded preservation comparisons, so a later failure identifies its
exact invariant without exposing protected database rows.

workflow_runs.name: Check
workflow_runs.display_title: vpsadmin: complete profile admission observations before staging

head_commit.message:
vpsadmin: complete profile admission observations before staging

The profile tasks start in autocommit mode, while storage mutation
admission requires a transaction to lock the freeze control row. Complete
short entry observations before discovering or staging work, leaving each
real writer responsible for its existing atomic admission check.

Release the observation transaction before orchestration or waits so queued
work is visible to other connections. Refresh and validate payload routing
before direct writes; this remains an observation and requires the operator
to avoid concurrent freeze changes during the write.

Cover actual autocommit staging visibility, bounded reader cleanup, freeze
refusals and fresh routing without changing schema or queue defaults.

workflow_runs.name: Check
workflow_runs.display_title: vpsadmin: test retained services through interrupted maintenance

head_commit.message:
vpsadmin: test retained services through interrupted maintenance

Exercise the real old and preserving seeds on one disposable services disk.
Keep writers masked from initial maintenance boot, copy the real closure,
and retry interrupted copy and copied boot without replacing retained data.

Use the pinned TestRunner's examples, results and cleanup with a narrow
constructor adapter for sealed configurations and one shared guest registry.
Check generator masks, writer starts, assignments and payload preservation.

Expose this as an explicit post-review app. Services-only coverage retains
starting_copied and cannot prove full-cluster Node refresh or hold release.

Keep default flake evaluation independent of the enabled candidate. Build
the two fixed store configurations only on invocation, preserving selected
sources, revision metadata and declared follows before the native runner
starts.

Keep both runtime-built configuration outputs rooted through native execution
and later failure inspection. Private roots stay outside the runner's initially
empty artifact directory so concurrent Nix GC cannot remove required closures.

Preserve the pinned machine lifecycle's five-second settle gap across
replacement instances after successful teardown. Use a monotonic stop
timestamp and wait only the remaining gap before start, retaining genuine
startup failures and the retained-disk recheck.

Flush the first copied boot's fixture counter and marker removal before the
deliberate power cut. Keep the new seed blocked and retain the two-start
assertion; a failed removal or filesystem sync must prevent the forced cut.

workflow_runs.name: Check
workflow_runs.display_title: flake: select automatic session naming runtime

head_commit.message:
flake: select automatic session naming runtime

Pin the runtime that accepts prompt-based session names and preserves
request identity through naming, initialization and browser recovery.
Retain the deployed maintenance and storage-profile extension lineage and
the runtime policy-3 ancestor.

Only the runtime and its codex-web dependency change. Site configuration,
cluster inputs, the Codex version and all other locked inputs are retained.
